elements.element: Upon expiry or termination of the Agreement for any reason, Licensor must provide transition assistance to Licensee.
elements.evidence: Subsection (c)(i) applies upon expiry or termination for any reason and requires Licensor, at Licensee's request, to provide reasonable transition assistance.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six (6) months.
elements.evidence: Subsection (c)(i) expressly provides for transition assistance “for up to six (6) months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Licensor's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: Subsection (c)(i) expressly states that assistance will be provided “at Licensor's then-current rates.”

elements.element: Licensor must return Licensee Data to Licensee.
elements.evidence: Subsection (c)(ii) requires Licensor to return to Licensee all defined “Licensee Data,” which covers data of or relating to Licensee, its customers, and its trades stored in or processed by the Licensed Technology.

elements.element: Licensee Data must be returned within thirty (30) days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Subsection (c)(ii) requires return “within thirty (30) days of such expiry or termination.”

elements.element: Licensee Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Subsection (c)(ii) requires return in a “commonly used, machine-readable format,” which satisfies the standard machine-readable-format requirement.

elements.element: After returning Licensee Data, Licensor must delete it from its systems.
elements.evidence: Subsection (c)(iii) requires Licensor to “thereafter delete all Licensee Data from its systems.”

elements.element: Licensor must certify deletion of Licensee Data thereafter.
elements.evidence: Subsection (c)(iii) requires Licensor to certify the deletion in writing to Licensee.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination of the Agreement, Licensor must provide transition assistance to Licensee.
elements.evidence: Subsection (c)(i) imposes this obligation upon expiry or termination for any reason, at Licensee's request.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for at least ninety (90) days.
elements.evidence: The clause makes assistance available for up to six months, which exceeds the fallback ninety-day period.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Licensor must export Licensee Data to Licensee.
elements.evidence: Subsection (c)(ii) requires Licensor to return all Licensee Data to Licensee in a commonly used, machine-readable format, constituting a data export.

elements.element: The Licensee Data export must occur within thirty (30) days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Subsection (c)(ii) expressly requires return within thirty days of expiry or termination.

result.reason: The operative redline satisfies every preferred requirement and therefore also satisfies the fallback. It is not minimal because the separate prohibition on withholding, suspending access to, or deleting Licensee Data adds restrictions beyond those needed for either position. The added survival language reasonably supports the post-termination obligations, and no contradiction with the remaining commercial terms is apparent. The transition provision is otherwise clear, though “thereafter” does not establish a specific deletion deadline and the pre-existing clause contains drafting errors such as “API's Documentation” and “Licensee as complied.”
